prompt: A flat layered paper-cut collage in a strict handcraft design system: everything is cut from colored cardstock and hanji paper with perfectly clean cut edges — NO outline of any kind on any piece: no bright edge line, no white edge, no dark contour line. Each object is built from two to five completely flat die-cut pieces layered ON THE OBJECT ITSELF — its own silhouette, a main color piece, one or two detail pieces and a highlight piece — the object is never placed on a base, platform, pedestal, plinth or pile of paper sheets; Every upper piece sits slightly RAISED above the piece beneath it, so along EVERY boundary where two different colors meet, the upper piece casts a soft narrow warm dark-brown shadow down onto the lower piece — a gentle embossed paper relief wherever two colors touch, and this relief shadow is the ONLY depth cue. Cut economy: every scissor cut is purposeful and confident — a shape that is straight in the real object is cut with a clean STRAIGHT edge, and curves appear ONLY where the real object is actually curved. No decorative wavy edges, no bumpy wobbly outlines, no gratuitous scalloping on untextured surfaces; a rectangular block is cut as a plain rectangle, though corners may be gently ROUNDED — softly rounding a corner is natural scissor work. Shapes stay simple and chunky, no detail finer than real scissors could cut. Scalloped repeat patterns for textures like straw or waves, cut big and loose. Strictly straight-on orthographic front view, zero perspective. No volume, no curvature, no folded paper, no sculpting. Real-scissors discipline: every piece is a shape that could actually be cut with scissors from a single sheet of colored paper. EACH PIECE IS EXACTLY ONE SOLID FLAT COLOR — no gradient, no shading, no airbrush, no painted detail inside a piece; every color change is a separate stacked paper piece, even a thin line is its own paper strip. ALL pieces share one identical fine colored-paper texture. All shadows are neutral warm dark-brown paper shadows, never colored. This is one DRAMATIC COMIC ACTION PANEL filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge (full-bleed, no border): bold dynamic composition, big flat paper speed-line strips, kid-friendly and funny, never scary. Cute, round, friendly Korean picture-book characters for 3-4 year olds: big round white paper eyes with dark pupils, small pink cheek circles, simple rounded shapes, never scary. Scene: a dark forest edge at night, three small frightened robbers (round chubby men with black moustaches, bandanas and striped shirts — cream and red, cream and green, cream and brown — exactly like three little paper dolls) huddle together at the LOWER LEFT, pointing at a thought-cloud. The thought-cloud is a cream paper cloud shape in the UPPER RIGHT, and INSIDE it are FOUR SMALL separate silly imagined things in a row, each clearly readable and each no bigger than a robber: (1) a small white bed-sheet ghost with two round yellow cat eyes, (2) a small long thin stick-figure with a sharp needle, (3) a small tall clumsy giant with big flat feet, (4) a small grumpy judge in a black hat shouting on a rooftop. All four are tiny, round and goofy, each a separate little paper cut-out with air around it; there is NO large creature, NO blob, nothing fills the cloud. Colour mood: gentle picture-book night — mid-tone blues, a cream moon, warm amber window light, soft sage hills, low saturation. IMPORTANT BRIGHTNESS: even though it is a night scene, render it as a BRIGHT, clearly readable picture-book night — all shapes easy to see; never near-black, never murky. No text anywhere. Full-bleed illustration, no lime green.
